competitor.name: Marsh McLennan
competitor.description: Global professional services firm specializing in risk, strategy, and people, operating Marsh, Guy Carpenter, Mercer, and Oliver Wyman.

items.title: Marsh McLennan Agency Acquires Regional P&C Brokerage Graham-Naylor
items.summary: Marsh McLennan Agency (MMA) expanded middle-market capabilities in the Southeast by acquiring Graham-Naylor Insurance, adding $28M in annual commercial lines revenue.

items.title: Marsh Launches AI-Powered Cyber Risk Quantifier for Middle Market
items.summary: Introduced Cyber Pulse, an underwriting analytics tool evaluating ransom vulnerabilities and expected claims loss distributions for mid-sized commercial clients.

items.title: Marsh Appoints Sarah Jenkins as Head of North American Commercial Lines
items.summary: Former Aon executive Sarah Jenkins joins Marsh to accelerate carrier syndication and streamline mid-market broker production across US regions.

items.title: MMA Acquires Great Lakes Employee Benefits Advisory
items.summary: MMA bolsters Midwest employee benefits group with acquisition of Cleveland-based advisory firm servicing 450 corporate employer groups.

items.title: Commercial Property Rate Benchmark Index Indicates Firming Renewals
items.summary: Marsh's quarterly pricing report reported average commercial property rate increases of 6.2%, advising clients to implement parametric disaster riders.

items.title: MMA Closes Deal for Pacific Northwest Construction Risk Specialist
items.summary: MMA completed purchase of Cascade Risk Partners, adding surety bond specialization and captive management for infrastructure contractors.

battlecard_template.headline: Aggressive Middle-Market Expansion via Serial MMA Tuck-Ins
battlecard_template.subtext: Marsh McLennan leverages MMA's regional brand rollups combined with Guy Carpenter reinsurance clout to squeeze independent brokers on middle-market renewals.

wins.title: Local High-Touch Broker Responsiveness
wins.text: Position our nimble, local dedicated account management against Marsh's tiered service desks where middle-market accounts are routed to centralized remote hubs.

wins.title: Transparent Broker Fee Architecture
wins.text: Highlight our clear, flat-fee advisory model against MMC's layered commission structures and contingent market service agreements.

wins.title: Specialty Underwriting Agility
wins.text: Leverage our regional E&S carrier relationships to deliver faster quote turnarounds on complex property and casualty risks.

moves.summary: Marsh McLennan Agency acquired Southeast regional broker Graham-Naylor Insurance.
Rolled out Cyber Pulse analytics tool evaluating ransomware exposure for mid-market accounts.
Appointed Sarah Jenkins to oversee North American commercial property and casualty operations.
